text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan racks up the wins. Gone<n>is the
self-doubting Umamusume who<n>once worried she
was unworthy of<n>the Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She races with pure determination,<n>focusing
exclusively on victory. It<n>seems that watching Ines
Fujin run<n>has helped her figure out her own<n>path
forward.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And it's not just Mejiro Ryan.<n>Everyone who sees
Ines Fujin run<n>finds themselves getting fired up.
Her<n>running fills countless people with<n>energy and
enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I imagine the cheers at the Satsuki<n>Sho will be even
louder. Everyone's<n>hoping to see her do her best...
and<n>win.
